description.zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account (agent logon name).
The acid in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate the value.
The connId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（	仅在双步转时传入）
description.en: The holdConnId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for two-step transfers.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.

description.zh: true:单步转，false:双步转，默认单步转
description.en:
Specifies whether to use a single-step transfer. Valid values:
- true: Single-step transfer.
- false: Two-step transfer.
Default value: true.
The jobId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 转交坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
description.en: The name of the target agent account (agent logon name) to which the call is transferred.

The transfer type. Valid values:
- 1: single-step transfer
- 2: two-step transfer
Default value: 1.
